property_tests.description: For any workspace that enters sync_status='syncing', sync_status eventually transitions to 'idle' or 'error' and never remains 'syncing' indefinitely across server restarts or context cancellations.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample workspaces in 'syncing' state by: (a) injecting context cancellation at random points during fetch, (b) simulating server restart with workspaces stuck in 'syncing', (c) running 100 sync operations with random fetch outcomes (success, network error, diverged)
property_tests.invariant_check: after each sync operation completes or server restarts, assert db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspaces WHERE sync_status=?', 'syncing') == 0 within 5 seconds; assert no workspace remains in 'syncing' state after server startup reconciliation completes

property_tests.description: For any successful fast-forward sync, the post-sync head_sha is always a descendant of the pre-sync head_sha and never a non-descendant commit.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random linear commit chains of length 1-50; for each chain, set local HEAD to a random ancestor commit and upstream HEAD to a random descendant; run sync and verify ancestry
property_tests.invariant_check: pre_sha = db head_sha before sync; post_sha = db head_sha after sync; assert is_ancestor(pre_sha, post_sha, repo) == true; assert post_sha != pre_sha (branch was advanced); assert is_ancestor(post_sha, pre_sha, repo) == false (not a regression)

property_tests.description: For any completed fetch operation (successful or diverged), upstream_head_sha is always updated to the fetched upstream HEAD SHA regardless of whether the integration branch was advanced.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 50 sync operations with random outcomes: (a) already up to date, (b) fast-forward, (c) diverged; record the upstream HEAD SHA returned by go-git before each sync
property_tests.invariant_check: expected_sha = sha_read_from_remote_before_sync; after sync completes (any outcome except fetch failure), assert db.query('SELECT upstream_head_sha FROM workspaces WHERE slug=?', slug)['upstream_head_sha'] == expected_sha

property_tests.description: For any pair of concurrent sync requests for the same workspace, at most one sync executes at a time and the second concurrent request receives HTTP 409.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each of 20 iterations: set workspace to idle, fire 2-10 concurrent POST /sync requests simultaneously using goroutines; collect all response statuses
property_tests.invariant_check: statuses = [r.status for r in concurrent_responses]; assert statuses.count(409) == len(statuses) - 1; assert statuses.count(200) + statuses.count(502) + statuses.count(409) == len(statuses); assert db.query('SELECT sync_status FROM workspaces WHERE slug=?', slug)['sync_status'] in ('idle', 'error')

property_tests.description: For any reclone operation from initiation to clone job completion, workspace status is 'active' at every observable point and is never set to any other value.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Run 20 reclone operations with varying archive push outcomes (success, failure) and clone job durations (10ms-2s); poll workspace status every 10ms throughout each operation
property_tests.invariant_check: status_observations = poll_workspace_status_every_10ms_during_reclone(slug); assert all(s == 'active' for s in status_observations); assert db.query('SELECT status FROM workspaces WHERE slug=?', slug)['status'] == 'active'

property_tests.description: For any workspace with sync_mode='disabled', every POST /sync request returns HTTP 400 without performing any git operations or state changes.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate 30 sync requests against workspaces with sync_mode='disabled' with varying workspace states (different sync_status, clone_status values); install spies on all git operations
property_tests.invariant_check: spy_fetch = install_spy(remote, 'Fetch'); spy_open = install_spy(PlainOpen); resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/{slug}/sync', auth=sync_token); assert resp.status == 400; assert spy_fetch.call_count == 0; assert spy_open.call_count == 0; pre_state = db_state_before; post_state = db_state_after; assert pre_state == post_state

property_tests.description: For any sync operation that results in sync_status='error', last_sync_at is not updated and retains its previous value.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 40 failing sync scenarios: (a) network error, (b) auth error, (c) diverged history, (d) context cancellation, (e) ref update failure; record last_sync_at before each sync
property_tests.invariant_check: pre_last_sync_at = db.query('SELECT last_sync_at FROM workspaces WHERE slug=?', slug)['last_sync_at']; trigger_failing_sync(); post_state = db.query('SELECT sync_status, last_sync_at FROM workspaces WHERE slug=?', slug); assert post_state['sync_status'] == 'error'; assert post_state['last_sync_at'] == pre_last_sync_at

property_tests.description: For any successful reset-to-upstream operation, sync_error is null and sync_status is 'idle' after completion, regardless of the previous sync_error value.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 20 reset-to-upstream operations with varying pre-existing sync_error values (null, short message, long message, special characters); vary the previous sync_status (error, idle)
property_tests.invariant_check: stub_fetch_and_ref_update_to_succeed(); resp = client.post('/api/v1/workspaces/{slug}/sync?reset_to_upstream=true', auth=sync_token); assert resp.status == 200; body = resp.json(); assert body['sync_error'] == null; assert body['sync_status'] == 'idle'; ws = db.query('SELECT sync_error, sync_status FROM workspaces WHERE slug=?', slug); assert ws['sync_error'] == null; assert ws['sync_status'] == 'idle'

property_tests.description: For any server startup sequence, no HTTP request can be processed before the startup reconciliation step completes and all stuck-syncing workspaces are reset.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each of 10 startup scenarios with 0-20 workspaces in 'syncing' state: start the server, immediately send HTTP requests, verify reconciliation completed before any request was handled
property_tests.invariant_check: reconciliation_complete_time = record_time_of_reconciliation_completion(); first_request_handled_time = record_time_of_first_request_handled(); assert reconciliation_complete_time <= first_request_handled_time; stuck_count = db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspaces WHERE sync_status=?', 'syncing')['count']; assert stuck_count == 0
